text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Les carburants et combustibles durables apporteront des contributions importantes à la réalisation des objectifs de la stratégie énergétique et de la stratégie climatique à long terme de la Suisse.", "gist": "Sustainable fuels will make significant contributions to Switzerland's long-term energy and climate strategy goals."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Sustainable Fuels and Platform Chemicals", "gist": "A funding call or research initiative name"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Office fédéral de l'aviation civile (OFAC)", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Civil Aviation"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "armasuisse", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office for Procurement and Infrastructure"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Les chercheurs doivent étudier comment la Suisse peut couvrir ses futurs besoins en carburants et combustibles durables et en produits chimiques de plateforme.", "gist": "Researchers are required to study how Switzerland can meet its future needs for sustainable fuels and platform chemicals."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Les technologies de production, de transport, de distribution, de stockage et d'utilisation doivent être développées.", "gist": "Production, transport, distribution, storage, and usage technologies must be developed."}]}
